answer: The spiral counter is kept in zephyr and thread makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 19 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
